description.la: Vita sancti Malachiae Hiberniae episcopi, ad Congamum abbatem scripta a Bernardo.
description.en-US: Bernard’s life of his friend Malachy, archbishop of Armagh, who died at Clairvaux in 1148: Ireland’s reform, the visit to Rome and the holy death, written for Abbot Congan of Inislounaght, with Mabillon’s chapter summaries. Latin only, from the Maurist text in Migne, a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: A vida de seu amigo Malaquias, arcebispo de Armagh, morto em Claraval em 1148: a reforma da Irlanda, a viagem a Roma e a santa morte, escrita para o abade Congano.

la.editor: Jean Mabillon, in J.-P. Migne (Patrologia Latina 182)

sources.edition: S. Bernardi Claraevallensis abbatis opera omnia, ed. J. Mabillon, in Migne, Patrologia Latina 182 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), work 6165, from machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: The complete text with Mabillon’s admonitio, chapter headings and summaries. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and so are the paragraph numbers; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed.
sources.tierEvidence: Bernard died in 1153; Migne’s printing is public domain everywhere.
